necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia, coded as I49.9 and R42. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197 for missing prior authorization.
